independentReview.scope: Static owned startup/runtime review found no remaining blocker after synchronous disposition and declaration repairs. No reviewer execution. Root subsequently added explicit-undefined policy coverage and repaired the package-manager verification harness.

scope: The canonical runner packages a checksum-pinned Playwright 1.60.0 runtime tree. Its 62 upstream files remain byte-identical except for one worker startup adaptation; local hook and modification notice files are added.

The callback receives original TestInfo after capture policy normalization, before live writes and user fixtures. Boolean disposition is synchronous, so delayed promises cannot restart the upstream allocation path after final stop.

CLI, test exports, globals and relative worker/loader imports use the same owned tree through ordinary module resolution. Original package name and exports preserve self-reference; an exact direct playwright-core dependency supports nested installations.

The public trace-off path discards private journal work at this boundary. Private tests exercise early journal ownership, original outcome policy and final export. Public automatic library trace policies remain unsupported.

Consumer verification uses isolated caches and compares installed canonical manifests, CLIs and every compiled file with the packed build. This detects stale private-version payloads independently of public identity and test success.
verification: Forty-three accepted groups cover declarations, ten provenance generators, owned runtime controls, journal admission, action steps, actual startup/adoption/off/finalizer suites, native runner fixtures, packed consumers, screenshot policies and package-manager layouts.

Every runtime compares 60 original and candidate attempts across eight policy spellings and two object-option variants, including explicit undefined values, retries, expected failures, callback modifiers and last skipped tests with no fixture entry. Twenty-five retained archives preserve non-clock records and exact resource bytes.

Six live-option attempts per runtime preserve original outcomes and publish bounded diagnostics without allocating the original live trace file. Actual and packed finalizer checks preserve capture failures, cleanup failures, late export custody and screenshot diagnostics.

Both Chromium variants retain the existing screenshot outcomes and image checks. Packed common matchers, filmstrip, dialogs and migration fixtures pass. Twenty fresh consumer layouts check installed bytes, aliases, declarations and native execution; Yarn Plug'n'Play runner use retains its explicit unsupported preflight.

The first 41 accepted groups use the same product source and compiled graph as the final two groups. Only two verification helpers changed to repair consumer cache isolation and add installed-file checks. Frozen archives and original failed reports remain retained.
initialFailuresAndRepairs: Declaration inference referenced an unexported upstream type subpath; explicit imported type namespace repaired it.
Review found asynchronous hook disposition could resume live allocation after final stop; synchronous boolean enforcement and late-resolution controls repaired it.
A private generated-fixture directory resolved the main checkout runtime; anchoring ordinary module resolution to the frozen checkout repaired isolation.
A private packed-output parent directory was missing; the harness created it and resumed remaining checks.
Bun shared cache supplied an older private package despite current registry metadata. Fresh per-consumer caches and installed payload hash checks repaired the verification gap.
The private Node command used an absolute executable without its bin directory on PATH. The remaining package-manager group was rerun with the pinned Node directory so npm could be found.
reproduce: tools/test-owned-runner-runtime.mjs, tools/test-runner-trace-adoption.mjs, tools/test-runner-trace-steps.mjs and tools/test-runner-trace-finalizer.mjs on Bun and Node 22/24.

tools/run-runner-trace-start-tests.mjs, tools/run-runner-trace-adoption-tests.mjs, tools/run-runner-trace-off-tests.mjs and tools/run-runner-trace-finalizer-tests.mjs on Bun and Node 22/24, including --packed finalizer cases.

tools/run-native-runner-tests.mjs and tools/test-packed-runner.mjs on Bun and Node 22/24; screenshot checks on both browser variants; packed common-matchers, filmstrip, dialogs and migration checks on Bun.

limitations: Automatic native trace coordination, logical admission across a full attempt, API context integration, complete interruption handling and source collection across library actions remain unfinished.
This source view excludes concurrent unintegrated API request changes. The accepted native release driver is reused unchanged; this slice does not rerun the Rust workspace.
Latest full core remains the earlier 126-group checkpoint. This focused follow-up is not fresh full-core, native Linux, performance, release or broader parity acceptance.
The original isolated runner dependency remains installed for types and build input, in addition to the packaged owned runtime. No publication or fastest-framework claim is made.
